recordingMethod: Chromium 151 CSS-pixel capture of forty-eight independent inert replays, split into ordinary and top-BREAK 24-case executions (local/opponent x active/sole bench x group q1/q2/q3 x middle/base initiator), of lower-card single/Alt-R against the checked-in board surface. Three-Pokemon construction, nonzero top-driven group histories, lower selection, layout sources, and controlled cardback bytes are inherited from digest-pinned dependencies. Keyboard and clicked-card ingress are digest-pinned but not executed; the application module is stubbed, and only the lower-selected single=true transition and two-animation-frame cleanup are narrowly transcribed from digest-pinned source.
